content: Mobile week mini-bar pattern: a flex row of 7 equal-width buttons showing abbreviated day name + date number. Each button has flex-1, today gets a filled circle on the date number (e.g., rounded-full bg-stone-900 text-white). Active (selected) day gets border-b-2 indicator or bold text. Pattern is used by Google Calendar, Apple Calendar on mobile. No scroll sync needed — clicking updates selectedDayIndex state directly. The mini-bar doubles as a week overview and a day navigator. Key UX: the mini-bar should always show the full week (Mon-Sun), not scroll itself. Position: sticky top-0 or fixed below the week navigation header.
